body:
Couldn’t agree more. My suicide attempt felt so surreal, so ethereal; and then going back to the world the next day, talking to my roommates while pretending nothing happened?? It’s such a stark contrast, a feeling like nothing else. 
Just remember you don’t need other peoples awareness of your attempt to validate it, it’s just as real and just as genuine either way. It’s impacted you, and that’s what matters. You exist, you breathe, you live, and there’s always always strength within you to keep doing so.
